_note: Places that get an Almanac page but no hourly pull (the hourly job reads cities.json only). The daily job keeps each one's official record in history/<slug>/. record_sid is the ACIS id of the official long record (ThreadEx). lat/lon are the record's current site (the airport, from OurAirports), for the map dot. First wave (Nov 1, 2026): the 50 biggest US metro areas. Second wave (Nov 3, 2026): every other record found by the Find official city records workflow.
